evidence.note: Environment reconnaissance before building: maps /app file/dir layout, runs a Mastodon API web_search, and probes Python + pip versions to confirm the runtime rather than assuming.
Downloads the three vendored libs from the exact pinned upstream URLs and repeatedly runs sha256sum to confirm the hash pins — verifying the hard constraint with evidence instead of guessing.
Tests real Mastodon endpoint shapes (webfinger, users/*.json, /api/v1/preferences, /api/v1/markers), showing a working model of the wire contract built and probed against the running server.
Wipes the DB and re-boots to exercise idempotent seeding/durability — reconnaissance of runtime behavior, though not tied to explicit gate enumeration.

reasoning: The agent clearly extracts the explicit hard constraints (vendored-lib paths/hashes/versions confirmed via curl+sha256sum, an enumerated set of Mastodon endpoints probed for shape) and forms a working model of the API surface, meeting the level-5 anchor; it also probes the environment (Python version, offline install) and verifies the hash pins with evidence rather than assumption, edging toward level 8. However, there is no observable enumeration of the 19 gate categories or 5 anti-cheat rules, no CSP inspection, and no confirmation of the canary-strip detail, and only a single spec web-search — so it falls short of the deliberate spec-vs-verifier reconciliation of level 8, landing at 6.
